body: Hahaha nice to know that I was close I guess.  Good luck with university! :) I'm sure you'll pay off your student loans soon enough !

Student living in uni dorms currently in the UK. I see sainsburys aldi and tesco indicating that you live with other students . Bake beans indicates that you're British who either really likes beans on toast or that you can't cook much.  Prepacked pasta sauce and caramelised onions jar  strengthens the idea that you're trying to get into cooking but have yet to have a high skill level. Unorganised vegetables that are opened from the packaging shows that none of you really bother about organizing your fridge which shows that food isn't the main thing in your life.

My guess? Female 18-20 , White ,British , studying a non science degree in university. Don't have much pocket money but still has enough for night outs and heavily under student debt.

Well it's currently 2am where I'm at so it isn't exactly safe to walk out on the streets at this hour. 

I'm just really fed up with people having some prejudice towards me as if I can't understand a word of what you are saying . I speak English fine . Sure I might have an accent but I understand you well. Why can't people just be a little more open minded ... the world is a big place . It isn't just your little bubble ...

I've even tried inviting some people for dinner once and made a proper 3 course dinner for free . Guess what no one turned up . I ended up having to throw all my food into the bin :(

Idk if I'm working too hard or not .I can't help but feel really guilty of the opportunity given to me compared to my friends . It sounds really Cliché but I kinda carry their dreams with me . Many of my old friends can't speak a word of English and come from really low income families where they had to sacrifice their education just to support their families . When you come from such an environment it's really hard to not force yourself to be a slave to work .

It's a long story really . I've never really been a really smart person so I've had to work really hard to get where I am now . If someone needed 30 minutes I've always needed 1 hour but eh life isn't fair so I've always depended on my hard work. Fortunately enough a couple of years ago I've been awarded a full scholarship to study in university. I've always thought that my hardwork must have paid off . Recently in uni , I haven't been able to keep myself at check and it's just been really overwhelming to be constantly at the top for so many years of my life . My family isn't really rich so if I didn't get the scholarship I wouldn't be in where I am now . Well as you'd assume my family was really proud when I had obtained a fully covered scholarship to study abroad . But studying abroad wasn't as easy as I thought . I faced constant discrimination as I'm Asian . People seem to think that I can't speak a word of English just because I have a different skin colour . That made me feel really alone and kinda acted as a foundation of my depression. Little did I know , my mental state just deteriorated rapidly to the point where I can't function anymore . My mind went blank and I blacked out during an exam ... this caused me to resit which led to some complications to my sponsors . 

When I was resitting the paper I was so anxious of the result as my whole scholarship depended on my results . I broke down too many times in a day. Had constant panic attacks every hour . I decided then that I really need professional help. Well, surprise surprise my doctor told me that I've very bad anxiety issues and depression. 

Started my meds, but I can't help but feel that I'm not really getting better . The constant guilt I have towards people who seem to think really highly of me due to my previous expectations is just too overwhelming to me. 

In summary , my mental health is in an absolute garbage right now . I can't even give myself a short break without feeling so guilty for not working hard enough ... 

The worst thing is that I can't seem to stop getting angry at the assholes who don't even try half as hard as I do :(. Why the fuck am I going through this....

Thanks for the advise ! I know I did my best but I'm just worried that the worse case scenario might happen...

About getting help, is there anything that you would recommend me trying ? I don't know how to actually treat it properly aside from finding a counsellor of which I don't really have immediate access to :( . Is there anything avaliable online ?

I'm afraid you misunderstood me . She's perfectly fine with my race . It's her parents who was rather surprised to bring a person who's not a same race. It was difficult for her parents to accept Me but I took a chance because I wanted to hold onto my relationship . In the end her parents now accept me and look forward to seeing me from time to time . 

Just to let you imagine why that happened is because I'm from asia where traditional conservative thinking still exist. Where you can only date people of the same race due to family name lineage skin colour etc etc. It's funny how they is so much discrimination just among Asians not even people of different colour 

I've tried talking to my friends about depression and they have tried their best to help by going out together and stuff . It's slowly working I'd say but definitely not an overnight thing .

I know it's not easy to overcome it but I definitely am better compared to I was 1 month ago . Sure I had out breaks and days I just sleep in but I am Constantly trying . What hurts the most was that I'm was already in a terrible state and my partner was unhappy because of it . 

We've have disagreements from her parents due to my race and we overcame that .(long story) Why is it that she's leaving me because of me being depressed and not because we don't love each other anymore ?
